name: Enterprise IT Modernization
description: Organizations modernizing IT — enterprise customers, legacy migration, security/compliance, cloud transformation, and complex integrations.

attributes.label: Enterprise customer base
attributes.description: Named enterprise logos, case studies, or Global 2000 customers.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find enterprise customer evidence: logo walls, Fortune/Global 2000 case studies, or named large enterprise customers.
negativeSignals: SMB-only positioning with no enterprise proof

attributes.label: Legacy / migration signals
attributes.description: Migration from legacy, mainframe, on-prem, or replace language.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find legacy or migration signals: migration guides, replace legacy X language, mainframe/on-prem modernization stories.
negativeSignals: Greenfield-only consumer app with no migration story

attributes.label: Security & compliance
attributes.description: SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or trust center presence.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find security and compliance evidence: SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, FedRAMP, trust center, or compliance badges.

attributes.label: IT/CIO leadership activity
attributes.description: CIO/CTO/CISO hiring or leadership commentary on IT transformation.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find IT leadership activity: CIO/CTO/CISO hires in the news, or leadership commentary on IT transformation.
positiveSignals: IT transformation leadership blog or interviews
Named IT executive sponsors in case studies
negativeSignals: No IT leadership signal in public sources

attributes.label: Cloud transformation narrative
attributes.description: Cloud migration, modernization, or hybrid cloud stories.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find cloud transformation narrative: cloud migration, modernization programs, hybrid cloud, or cloud partnership stories.
negativeSignals: Explicitly anti-cloud / on-prem only with no cloud story

attributes.label: Budget / RFP / digital initiatives
attributes.description: Digital transformation programs, RFPs, or modernization budgets.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find budget, RFP, or digital initiative signals: RFPs, transformation programs, or modernization budget mentions.

attributes.label: Complex integration surface
attributes.description: Enterprise integrations (ERP, IAM, SIEM, ITSM) and SSO/SAML.
attributes.researchPrompt: For company {domain}, find complex enterprise integrations: ERP, IAM, SIEM, ITSM connectors, SSO/SAML, or long enterprise connector lists.
